title: VOSSLER & SON — Instruments of Legacy
description: A luxury landing page for VOSSLER & SON, a fictional 4th-generation master luthier atelier rooted in the Cremona tradition. Warm amber-dark palette (#1E1509 bg) with amber varnish accents, Playfair Display + Crimson Pro typography. Full sections: SVG violin preloader, cinematic full-screen hero with animated headline, 4-generation heritage timeline, 3-instrument showcase grid with specs, 7-step creation process, notable commissions for soloists, workshop visit with booking form, testimonials from concert soloists, commission enquiry form, and footer. Fixed left scroll indicator in amber. GSAP 3.12.2 + ScrollTrigger animations throughout.
